LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.ThirstHours.D: Hours from 80% thirst to empty (25°C, before heat acceleration and low-thirst slowdown). Default 20, range 4–72. Lower means thirstier pawns.
Thirst rate multiplier for animals (wild, livestock, pets); humanlikes are unaffected. Default 0.50, so the same water lasts twice as long and wild animals rarely die of thirst; 1.00 matches vanilla pacing.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.FoodWater.Des: Every food restores thirst by nutrition × this factor. Default 0.25 (a 1.0-nutrition meal is about 1.25 bottles); 0 disables. Herbivores and carnivores eating their own food use the two fixed values below instead.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.AnimalPlantTh: Fixed thirst a herbivore gets per meal of plant food (grass, trees, vegetables, fungus, seeds). Default 0.10; 0 disables and falls back to the nutrition-based value.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.AnimalMeatThi: Fixed thirst a carnivore gets per meal of meat or a corpse. Default 0.10; 0 disables and falls back to the nutrition-based value.
Adjust what one bottle of mineral water, purified water, or boiled water does. Changes apply the next time someone drinks.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.Water.PerLite: Thirst restored per liter of water. Default 0.65 (one 1 L bottle restores about 65%, roughly 13 hours at the default 20 h). Bottles, the water pouch, buckets/basins, taps and patient feeding all use this value; range 0.05–2.00.
LanguageData.ColonyKit.Settings.Hygiene.Water.Mineral: When off, mineral water is treated as clean and no untreated-water contamination check is made. Purified water and boiled water never cause poisoning.
